newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura shares climb on media reports.
newsitem.headline: Nomura shares climb on media reports.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd jumped after being quoted bid-only on Tuesday morning, as buy-backs were prompted by media reports that Nomura's president and other directors with voting rights would resign to take responsibility for a recent scandal.
A Nomura spokeman said the company would not confirm the media reports.
By 0033 GMT, the share price had climbed 50 yen to 1,350. Its volume was 3.173 million shares, the heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Kyodo news agency, quoting industry sources, said the president and all nine directors with voting rights would soon step down to take responsibility for the scandal, linked to corporate racketeers.
Mass-circulation daily Yomiuri Shimbun also said on Tuesday that Nomura may decide on the resignations at a meeting of top management to be held on Tuesday.
